metaDescription: Model development for a specific prediction or design problem.
heroTitle: A model built for your target or host organism, not a generic one bent to fit it.
heroDescription: For programs with a specific prediction or design task — a target family, a modality, an enzyme class, a host organism, an endpoint — where an off-the-shelf model doesn't quite match the data or the question.
capabilities: Model development scoped to one specific prediction or design problem
Training on your proprietary or partner datasets, kept private to your project
Evaluation against your own experimental ground truth
Deployment into your existing systems, not a standalone tool nobody uses
